biography: Steve Ruston, a name synonymous with flash and fearless driving, hails from a small village in the Cotswolds. His racing journey began unconventionally – not with karting, but with a souped-up ride-on lawnmower he terrorized the local golf course with as a teenager. It was this raw, untamed passion that caught the eye of a local Caterham enthusiast, who sponsored his entry into the Superlight series. Ruston quickly proved his mettle, demonstrating an uncanny ability to extract every last drop of performance from his machine. His audacious overtakes and devil-may-care attitude both thrilled and infuriated the paddock. While he's yet to clinch a championship, Ruston remains a prominent figure in the Caterham scene, ever threatening to upset the established order. He is currently seeking sponsorship to move into prototype racing.
drivingStyle: Ruston's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos.' He's an aggressive late-braker, often diving into corners with a level of commitment that borders on recklessness. While this approach can lead to spectacular overtakes, it also results in the occasional off-track excursion. He's known for his exceptional car control and ability to adapt to changing track conditions, but his tire management has been a consistent area for improvement. Pressure, however, doesn't seem to faze him; Ruston thrives in high-stakes situations, often delivering his best performances when the spotlight shines brightest.

rivalries.name: Marcus Thorne
rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision at Brands Hatch in 2021, where Ruston accused Thorne of deliberately forcing him off the track.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Rossi
rivalries.reason: A constant battle for the top spot in the Caterham Superlight series, with Rossi's calculated consistency often clashing with Ruston's raw speed.

rivalries.name: David Coulson Jr.
rivalries.reason: Junior's father was a mentor to Ruston and Coulson Jr feels that Ruston has disrespected that mentor by not being more of a team player in the past.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, regardless of the weather.
Listens to a specific heavy metal track ('Highway Star' by Deep Purple) precisely three times before every race.
Insists on polishing his helmet visor himself, believing it improves his focus.
famousQuote: "Life's too short to drive slow. If you're not on the edge, you're taking up too much space."
careerHighlight: Winning the wet race at Oulton Park in 2020, where he overtook three cars in the final lap to secure a stunning victory, showcasing his exceptional car control in treacherous conditions.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at Silverstone in 2022 due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential championship-deciding win and leaving him visibly distraught.
